column1: # ogkm_register_gpu.tsv — MEASURED layout of UVM_REGISTER_GPU_PARAMS at every
# published NVIDIA open-gpu-kernel-modules tag nvkvm supports.
# Every cell here was produced by compiling and RUNNING a sizeof/offsetof probe
# against that tag's own headers (kernel-open/nvidia-uvm/uvm_ioctl.h +
# uvm_types.h), not by reading, inferring, or copying from gVisor.  A cell the
# sweep could not compile would read MISSING and a tag it could not clone would
# read CLONE_FAIL; neither appears below, so all 216 rows are measurements.
# This file is committed on purpose.  src/common/nvkvm_abi.h asserts that
# UVM_REGISTER_GPU is 40 bytes at every supported driver, and that assertion is
# what licenses NVKVM_UVM_REGISTER_GPU_* being flat constants rather than a row
# in struct nvkvm_abi_profile.  Before this file existed the only artifact
# backing it was an uncommitted scratch .tsv outside the repo, so the evidence
# did not survive a clone and the claim could not be rechecked by a reviewer.
# tests/abi_parity/ogkm_fixture_test.go now compares the shipped constants and
# our own struct against these rows.
# generated-start: 2026-08-26T13:20:16Z
# command: tools/abi_derive.sh --all-published-supported --format tsv --jobs 8 --work $WORK
# nvkvm-commit: a15db4d (tools/abi_derive.sh as of this tree)
# tag-list: git ls-remote --refs --tags https://github.com/NVIDIA/open-gpu-kernel-modules.git,
#           filtered to numeric tags matching ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){1,2}$ with major in [515,610],
#           sorted -V.  That is exactly what --all-published-supported enumerates.
# tags: 216
# result: one layout at all 216 tags — size 40, rmCtrlFd@24, hClient@28,
#         hSmcPartRef@32, rmStatus@36.  Zero MISSING, zero CLONE_FAIL.
#         There is no version boundary in this struct across the supported range.
# note: OGKM's first release is 515; 470 and earlier have no public source and
#       cannot be probed by this tool.  That is a documented gap, not a zero.
# raw-output: ogkm_abi_sweep_20260826.tsv holds the unedited 14-field sweep this
#             file is a five-column projection of.
# Columns are the tag plus the five uvm_register_gpu_* fields of the sweep, in
# the order ogkm_fixture_test.go's wantColumns expects.  Regenerate with the
# command above and keep this header.
tag
